recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If validator batch-file examples are ever reintroduced, ensure they download a FHIR resource representation such as XML or JSON rather than an HTML narrative page.
issue_request: FHIR-12296 was a Published/Persuasive technical correction for validation.html reporting that a Windows batch-file example downloaded http://hl7.org/fhir/patient-example.html, saving an HTML page instead of a valid Patient resource.
initial_application: No current commit mentions FHIR-12296 by Jira key, but commit b0959a6ba25a21c2b96dc8ba1be718ddb7b4f4fa ('#9896 - fix typos in validation example batch file') changed the example from patient-example.html to patient-example.xml and updated the validator input filename.
additional_context: source/validation.html is in current build scope via source/hierarchy.xml and publish.ini. Later commit 472abf78c495c2ae44924d499be7434ed50788d0, applying FHIR-31735, split validator tooling guidance out of the specification and removed the old Windows batch-file example entirely. Zulip and Confluence searches found no relevant conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because the reported bad command is absent from the current build-scoped validation page and the historical correction is already present in source history.
